rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.
prompt:

CHANGE ONLY CLOTHING: add a clearly visible opaque ivory-white HIGH-NECK LONG-SLEEVED UNDER-TUNIC underneath his existing draped ceremonial robes and gold jewelry. This must fully cover his chest, abdomen, right and left shoulders, upper arms, forearms and wrists; his two hands and face remain exposed. Make the under-tunic read unmistakably as woven fabric with a high collar, garment seams and folds, not as white bare skin. Keep the existing flowing outer robes and belt. No naked torso, nipples, bare shoulder or bare arm. Preserve dignity and respect for this living Hindu religion.
PRESERVE EXACTLY: same one-headed two-armed white male deity and facial features; same right hand gripping ONE large mace; same left hand gripping the reins; same divine forward-driving action; exactly THREE white horses with exactly three heads; exactly THREE wheels in the same coherent three-wheeled chariot arrangement; same harnesses and each hand position; same square composition, camera, moon, night vegetation, dust, rich textures, moonlight and palette. Keep all three wheels and all three horse heads visible. Do not add, remove or move any objects.
Claim grounding: white deity/mace/three-wheeled chariot/white horses chandra-c09; moonlight, night and vegetation chandra-c01; shining appearance chandra-c03. Clothing is a conservative editorial choice to obey full opaque garment rules, not a new research fact.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudo-writing, logo, frame, border, watermark, signature, gore, nudity, extra heads, arms, limbs, horses or wheels; no magical aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, additional weapons, film/game/anime/comic designs. Change only the tunic coverage.
source_generation_prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of CHANDRA, the Hindu Moon deity associated with night and vegetation, depicted respectfully as an awe-inspiring divine presence, not an ordinary man standing before a moon [chandra-c01].
ANATOMY: one white-complexioned male deity, one head, two arms, two legs under complete opaque ivory Indian ceremonial garments. He grips ONE large readable antique-metal mace upright in his right hand; his left hand controls the reins. His chariot has EXACTLY THREE WHEELS: two large rear side wheels and one centered front wheel, all three visible through a carefully constructed oblique frontal camera. Exactly THREE WHITE HORSES pull this coherent three-wheeled chariot; three separate heads, necks and bodies, normal horse anatomy. The white deity, mace, three-wheeled chariot and white horses are his documented iconography [chandra-c09]. Do not add a crescent crown, extra arms, wings or additional divine weapons.
MOMENT: Chandra drives the chariot forward over a dark hillside toward the low viewer, robes and reins sweeping with the movement; his commanding gaze looks down toward the viewer. He raises the substantial mace as a clear divine attribute, without attacking anyone. Three horses surge toward the foreground with distinct heads and physically coherent harnesses. This is an active divine arrival, not a calm standing portrait.
POWER: a bright silver moon illuminates Chandra's white face, mace, moving horses and actual leaves of the night vegetation; lunar radiance physically catches cloth, metal and leaves [chandra-c01,chandra-c03]. Moonlight is the only supernatural domain cue; no invented plant growth, curse effects, storms, energy beams or destruction. Do not make the moon a decorative halo or an oversized disk directly behind his head.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low oblique frontal angle; Chandra's head, torso, mace and sweeping clothed arms fill the upper two-thirds of the square and dominate the composition; the chariot and three surging horses occupy the lower third. Close monumental perspective and strong foreshortening communicate reverence without asserting giant anatomical size. Keep the complete mace head inside the frame. Show the three wheels as an intentional triangular tricycle layout: a centered smaller forward wheel beneath the front footboard and two larger rear side wheels, one near and one far. Maintain readable deity and mace silhouette at 200 pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: dominant cool silver moonlight from an off-center visible moon in a dark night sky; deep warm walnut shadows, antique gold highlights on real chariot metal, sharp silver rim light; ordinary dust lifted by the moving wheels, no luminous dust magic.
SURFACE: textured woven ivory garments, aged brass chariot, weathered carved wood with plain unlettered geometric decoration, white horse hair, rich painterly brushwork; silver-white divine complexion differentiated from the horses; dignified mature angular face with intense focused eyes.
SETTING: night with dark plants and vegetation beneath the chariot, from his documented moon/night/plants domain [chandra-c01]. No invented temples, other gods, devotees or narrative episodes.
MOOD: overwhelmingly majestic and awe-inspiring, a respected deity in a living Hindu tradition; imposing and authoritative, never monstrous, cute, decorative or mundane. Clear divine iconography and active movement answer the rejected ordinary-human image.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: ONE square image; no text, lettering, pseudo-writing, logo, border, frame, watermark or signature; no extra heads, limbs, fingers, horses or wheels; no design borrowed from films, games, anime or comics; no nudity, gore, violence against people or religious mockery; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, magical runes, crescent weapon, additional moon disks or floating ornaments.
